correctness.rationale: Each order-five de Bruijn cycle has one rooted 00000 occurrence and corresponds uniquely to a reversible 5-bit feedback map T_g(a,u)=(u,a XOR g(u)), g on 16 four-bit arguments; checking all 2^16 truth tables and a full 32-state orbit is exhaustive, not sampling. A second Euler-tour characterization on the four-bit de Bruijn graph supplies an independent structural enumeration. Periodic complexity is L=32-v_(x+1)(sum w_i*x^i) over F_2 because x^32-1=(x+1)^32; sidelobe P=max_{1<=t<=31}|32-2d_H(W,shift_t W)|. The bundled verifier implements polynomial/Games–Chan and signed/XOR comparisons. Independent feedback-table enumeration reproduced 2048 cycles, all 32 nonzero joint cells and their exact 32 integer counts, 12 with P=4, and 8 with L=31,P=4. Proof of exhaustiveness is fixed order-five, not an infinite extrapolation.
residual_risks: Enumeration and exact table are confined to order five with rotations identified but not reversal/complement.
Periodic absolute sidelobes are different from aperiodic correlation or system-level performance.
